recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, outdoor portrait of a woman in a lavender-blue hooded jumpsuit, seated in a pensive pose against a lush, blurred green background with circular bokeh. The composition features a high-contrast typographic header and a left-aligned tracklist in a typewriter-style slab serif.
coreVisualRelationships: The lavender-blue of the clothing contrasts against the deep green and teal tones of the background.
The woman's pensive, downward gaze creates a diagonal line leading from the top right toward the center left.
The stark white typography at the top provides a sharp horizontal anchor against the soft-focus imagery.
coreInvariants: Circular bokeh in the background greenery
Pensive, seated pose with hands near the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space, leaning inward toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands serve as the primary focal point, framed by the hood.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left title, moves across to the top-right title, then follows the subject's gaze down to the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper left and center left, filled with blurred foliage and bokeh.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a slightly faded, vintage film quality; high value contrast between the white text and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool tones (blues, greens, purples) with white accents

letterConstructionRules: Wide character width for display text
Condensed, typewriter-like spacing for body text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching slab serif families with varied weights and widths to distinguish title from metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style of the header.
Approximates the typewriter-style slab serif used for the tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus photograph of a woman with dark curly hair wearing a lavender-blue hooded jumpsuit. She is seated outdoors, leaning forward with her chin resting on her hands, looking pensive. The background is a dark, lush green forest with large, soft circular bokeh highlights. The lighting is diffused and cool-toned.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase white slab-serif text at the top, split between the left and right corners. Add a left-aligned list of text in a smaller, condensed white slab-serif font in the middle-left area of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the hood clearly visible and framing the face?
Is the background bokeh soft and circular?
Is the typography pure white and slab-serif?
Is the color palette dominated by cool greens and lavender-blue?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the lavender jumpsuit
Amount of grain in the film texture
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face.
Check that the lavender color is distinct from the green background.
Verify the slab serifs are thick and prominent.
Confirm the pose conveys a pensive or soulful emotion.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus, cool-toned outdoor portrait with a monochromatic wardrobe and structured, white slab-serif typography placed in the negative space.
